lede: I would most like to hear from teams securing AI or edge deployments, and from people breaking into security who want a peer to compare notes with.

reasons.title: Speaking or teaching
reasons.text: on securing AI and agents, zero trust for the edge and private 5G, and explaining security risk to executives.

reasons.title: Advising
reasons.text: teams deciding how to secure AI workloads, IoT fleets or private networks.

reasons.title: Collaboration
reasons.text: on security research and open-source labs for AI and edge systems.

reasons.title: Mentoring
reasons.text: career changers, especially from telecom, sales or support, moving into technical and security roles.

closing: Specific questions get better answers. "How do we keep an on-prem LLM from leaking customer data?" is a great first message.
